theorems.name: Submission.dorag_lip_bad_set_measure_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid (n + k))) (e : Euclid (n + k) → ℝ) (ξ : Euclid (n + k)) (σ₀ a : ℝ), 0 < σ₀ → 0 < a → (∀ y ∈ closedBall ξ (3 * σ₀ / 4), ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ 5 * σ₀ / 4 → μ (closedBall y t) ≤ 2 * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n)) → μ (closedBall ξ (3 * σ₀ / 4) \ {y | y ∈ μ.support ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ σ₀ / 2 → ∫⁻ x in closedBall y (t / 2), ENNReal.ofReal (e x) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (a * t ^ n)}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (5 / 2) ^ n / a) * unitBallVolume n * ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ σ₀, ENNReal.ofReal (e x) ∂μ
